Exa's published price for a standard search is **$7 per 1,000 requests**, but one Exa page lists a lower starting price, so the figures conflict.

- **$7 per 1,000 (most sources):** Exa's 2026 blog comparison lists a search at $7 per 1,000 requests with up to 10 results and users can configure latency from 180 milliseconds to 1 second. Another Exa comparison says the $7 price covers 10 results with text and highlights included, so $0.007 per call.
- **$4 per 1,000 (one page):** Exa's AI assistants use-case page says Exa Search starts at $4 per 1,000 requests. It also says each request includes up to 10 results with the instant search type. The coding use-case page repeats the $4 figure.
- **Other rates:** Answer costs $5 per 1,000, Contents (page text from known URLs) costs $1 per 1,000 pages, and Monitors cost $15 per 1,000 requests.
- **Free tier:** The free plan includes $20 in credits at sign-up and $10 each month.

The $7 figure appears in more sources and is newer, so it is likely the current standard price. I would confirm the $4 figure on Exa's pricing page before relying on it.

content.text:
Exa charges about **$7 per 1,000 searches**. That's for a standard search returning up to 10 results, with text and highlights included.

Exa's own pages disagree, though. Two use-case pages say search "starts at" **$4 per 1,000** for the instant search type. Most other sources, including the newer blog comparisons, say $7. Check Exa's pricing page before you rely on either number.

Other rates I found:
- **Answer:** $5 per 1,000.
- **Contents** (page text from URLs you already have): $1 per 1,000 pages.
- **Monitors:** $15 per 1,000 requests.
- **Free tier:** $20 in credits at sign-up and $10 each month.

Sources:
- [The 8 best AI search APIs in 2026](https://exa.ai/blog/best-ai-search-apis)
- [The 8 best web search tools for AI agents in 2026](https://exa.ai/blog/best-web-search-tools-for-ai-agents)
- [Exa vs SerpAPI: Search API Benchmarks and Comparison](https://exa.ai/versus/serpapi)
- [LLM Web Search API for AI Assistants and Chatbots](https://exa.ai/use-cases/ai-assistants)
- [Current Docs and Code Search for Coding Agents](https://exa.ai/use-cases/coding)
